reports.title: Low Street Lighting on North Pedestrian Walkway
reports.description: Street lamps behind Gate 1 along the residential side street are flickering or completely unpowered after 7:30 PM. Pedestrians waiting for ride-shares are advised to stay near the main guard booth.
reports.locationName: UMT - North Main Gate 1 (C-Block)
reports.corroborationNotes: 7 independent community members corroborated this recurring issue in this area.

reports.title: Active Police Patrolling at Khayaban-e-Jinnah Intersection
reports.description: Punjab Police Dolphin Squad van stationed at the roundabout near Shaukat Khanum & UCP approach. Well-lit corridor with active shopfronts and safe pedestrian transit until 11 PM.
reports.locationName: UCP - Shaukat Khanum / UCP Public Bus Stop
reports.corroborationNotes: 3 independent community members corroborated this report.

reports.title: Road Surface Hazard & Construction Detour
reports.description: Open drainage trench near the corner of MM Alam Road commercial strip undergoing sewer replacement. Narrowed pedestrian walking path with uneven footing. Exercise caution in flat footwear.
reports.locationName: Gulberg - MM Alam Road Commercial Strip
reports.corroborationNotes: 2 independent community reports logged in this sector.

reports.title: Active Dolphin Squad Patrolling at Khayaban-e-Jinnah Intersection
reports.description: Punjab Police Dolphin Squad van stationed at the roundabout near Shaukat Khanum & UCP approach. Well-lit corridor with active shopfronts and safe pedestrian transit until 11 PM.
reports.locationName: UCP - Shaukat Khanum / UCP Public Bus Stop
reports.corroborationNotes: 9 independent community members corroborated this recurring issue in this area.
reports.resolvedNote: Streetlights on this corridor were fully restored by PHA maintenance crew this morning.

reports.title: Defective High-Mast Streetlights on Southern Service Lane
reports.description: Four consecutive streetlights on the southern service road leading toward the university parking are unpowered. Footpaths are pitch black after 7 PM. Students walking to ride-shares are advised to stay on the main boulevard side.
reports.locationName: UCP - South Service Road & Faculty Parking
reports.corroborationNotes: 4 independent students logged poor lighting on this service road.

reports.title: Speeding Auto-Rickshaws & Reckless U-Turns at Main Roundabout
reports.description: Auto-rickshaws frequently make blind illegal U-turns across the pedestrian crosswalk outside Gate 1. Multiple near-misses observed during the 4:30 PM class departure rush. Traffic wardens requested.
reports.locationName: UCP - Main Entrance Gate 1 (Khayaban-e-Jinnah)
reports.corroborationNotes: 3 independent reports recorded regarding reckless traffic at Gate 1.

reports.title: Safe Student Waiting Booth Installed Opposite Shaukat Khanum Stop
reports.description: Punjab Safe Cities Authority and City Traffic Police have deployed a sheltered waiting booth with surveillance cameras and emergency 15 speed-dial signage directly across from the public bus stop.
reports.locationName: UCP - Shaukat Khanum / UCP Public Bus Stop
reports.corroborationNotes: Issue formally resolved by municipal administration & university security.
reports.resolvedNote: Safe sheltered waiting booth operational with PSCA 15 helpline terminal and high-visibility LED lighting.

reports.title: Unlit Pedestrian Stretch Behind UCP Sports Pavilion
reports.description: The narrow connecting lane behind the university ground toward private hostels lacks functional lighting. Groups loitering on motorcycles noticed between 8 PM and 10 PM. Female students should avoid walking alone.
reports.locationName: UCP - South Service Road & Faculty Parking
reports.corroborationNotes: 7 independent community members corroborated this recurring issue in this area.
reports.resolvedNote: Streetlights on this corridor were fully restored by PHA maintenance crew this morning.

reports.title: Harassment & Catcalling from Tinted Cars near Khayaban-e-Jinnah Service Rd
reports.description: Unregistered cars with tinted windows slowing down and catcalling female students waiting for vans near the fuel pump service lane. Incident reported to Dolphin squad dispatch.
reports.locationName: UCP - Shaukat Khanum / UCP Public Bus Stop
reports.corroborationNotes: 6 independent community reports logged regarding vehicle harassment here.

reports.title: CCTV Blindspot Near Back Turn Towards Lake City Link
reports.description: The turn connecting the rear university perimeter to the residential connector road is completely outside PSCA camera coverage. Guard booth is unmanned after 6 PM.
reports.locationName: UCP - South Service Road & Faculty Parking
reports.corroborationNotes: 2 independent community reports logged in this sector.

reports.title: Deep Open Trench Left Open After Fiber-Optic Cable Laying
reports.description: Open trench on the pedestrian walkway near the main gate has been completely filled and covered with concrete pavers following reports.
reports.locationName: UCP - Main Entrance Gate 1 (Khayaban-e-Jinnah)
reports.corroborationNotes: Repaired by telecom contractors & LDA engineering wing.
reports.resolvedNote: Trench backfilled, compacted, and concrete pedestrian tiles restored.

reports.title: Dedicated Rescue 1122 First-Aid Response Booth Active
reports.description: Emergency Rescue 1122 motorbike first-responder unit stationed near the Shaukat Khanum signal approach during peak student commute hours (8 AM - 5 PM).
reports.locationName: UCP - Shaukat Khanum / UCP Public Bus Stop
reports.corroborationNotes: Single community observation verified by campus network.

reports.title: Late-Night Ride-Hailing Pick-Up Safe Zone Outside Gate 1
reports.description: Designated brightly lit waiting bay with private university security guard present until 10 PM. Ideal spot for students awaiting InDrive or Yango drivers.
reports.locationName: UCP - Main Entrance Gate 1 (Khayaban-e-Jinnah)
reports.corroborationNotes: 5 independent students confirmed this as the safest pick-up point.

reports.title: Broken Footpath Curb Causing Female Pedestrians to Walk on Main Road
reports.description: Crumbled curb stones for approximately 30 meters near the bus stop force pedestrians onto the fast-moving lane during rain or dust storms.
reports.locationName: UCP - Shaukat Khanum / UCP Public Bus Stop
reports.corroborationNotes: 3 independent reports recorded regarding damaged footpath.

reports.title: Streetlight Circuit Repaired by LDA Along UCP Approach
reports.description: LDA electrical division replaced damaged underground cables. All 8 high-output LED streetlights along the boulevard approach are now fully operational.
reports.locationName: UCP - Main Entrance Gate 1 (Khayaban-e-Jinnah)
reports.corroborationNotes: Repaired by LDA Electrical Maintenance team.
reports.resolvedNote: High-mast LED fixtures tested and illuminating the entire 200m approach corridor.

reports.title: Low Street Lighting on North Pedestrian Walkway
reports.description: Street lamps behind Gate 1 along the residential side street are flickering or completely unpowered after 7:30 PM. Pedestrians waiting for ride-shares are advised to stay near the main guard booth.
reports.locationName: UMT - North Main Gate 1 (C-Block)
reports.corroborationNotes: 5 independent students and commuters confirmed this recurring issue.

reports.title: Aggressive Rickshaw Drivers Blocking Female Gate 2 Exit

reports.locationName: UMT - Female Gate 2 & Hostel Approach Road
reports.corroborationNotes: 5 independent students corroborated persistent harassment at Gate 2.

reports.title: Safe Transit Corridor Active Along Bagh-e-Jinnah Commercial Market
reports.description: Active shopfronts, bright streetlights, and regular security guards from surrounding banks make the commercial strip opposite UMT safe for walking until 10:30 PM.
reports.locationName: UMT - Bagh-e-Jinnah Commercial Market (Opposite UMT)
reports.corroborationNotes: 3 independent community members logged this as a verified safe route.

reports.title: Open Stormwater Drain Grating on Approach to C-Block Market

reports.corroborationNotes: Resolved by WASA emergency civil maintenance wing.
reports.resolvedNote: New concrete slab secured flush with road surface, hazard eliminated.

reports.title: Frequent Loitering and Staring Around Evening Ride-Share Stand

reports.locationName: UMT - North Main Gate 1 (C-Block)
reports.corroborationNotes: 4 independent community reports logged regarding evening loitering.

reports.title: Broken Sidewalk Pavers Near Shuttle Bus Roundabout
reports.description: Loose interlocking paving stones near the shuttle boarding point pose tripping hazards, especially when carrying heavy bags in low light.
reports.locationName: UMT - UMT Roundabout & Shuttle Pick-up Zone
reports.corroborationNotes: Single observation logged by student pedestrian.

reports.title: Punjab Police Mobile Check-Post Stationed Every Evening

reports.corroborationNotes: 6 independent community reports verify regular police checkpoint.

reports.title: Unmonitored Private Hostel Lane Behind UMT C-Block

reports.corroborationNotes: 3 independent hostelites confirmed low visibility on this route.

reports.corroborationNotes: Resolved by LESCO Johar Town Sub-division team.
reports.resolvedNote: Sagging cables re-tensioned and encased in protective conduit pipe.

reports.title: Well-Lit Community Walkway Near UMT Central Library Boundary
reports.description: Newly installed floodlights along the internal and external library boundary wall illuminate the entire pathway toward Gate 1. Highly safe for evening walks.
reports.locationName: UMT - North Main Gate 1 (C-Block)
reports.corroborationNotes: 2 community members verified safe walkway.

reports.title: Suspicious Unregistered Motorbikes Circling Evening Bus Bay

reports.locationName: UMT - UMT Roundabout & Shuttle Pick-up Zone
reports.corroborationNotes: Single observation logged, shared for awareness.

reports.title: Female Security Guard Stationed Permanently at Gate 2 Waiting Area

reports.resolvedNote: Permanent security booth deployed with female officer and emergency radio link.

reports.title: Unlit Stretches Along Canal Bank Feeder Road to UOL

reports.title: Pedestrian Overhead Bridge Lights Repaired & Cleaned

reports.title: Flooded Mud Pathway Near University Sports Complex Gate

reports.title: Dolphin Squad Checkpoint Stationed at Defence Road Roundabout

reports.title: Installed Emergency Alarm Pillar Near Girls Hostel Block

reports.title: Active Dolphin Squad Bike Patrol Operating Hourly in G Block

reports.title: Open Manhole on Link Road to Khayaban-e-Firdousi Capped
